description: The seven-member sorting example of RFC 8785 section 3.2.3, verbatim. Under the conforming UTF-16-code-unit order the emoji key sorts between U+20AC and U+FB33; under a code-point sort it moves to the end. Included because it is the RFC's own witness for the ordering rule, so a reader need not take kat-18's minimal pair on trust.
